LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 5.1.1 STORYTELLING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.1: Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Storytelling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Storytelling, part of Strand 5 in Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to pass culture from one generation to another?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to a story from a good narrator or a digital or electronic device on the African community values (respect, unity and hard work),

2. discuss the lessons learnt from the story,

3. identify the features that made the story telling session interesting,

4. work with peers to put together a collection of proverbs and wise sayings,

5. discuss the meaning of the proverbs and wise sayings,

6. write the proverbs and wise sayings on sentence strips and display them in class,

7. create proverbs and sayings

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to a story from a good narrator or a digital or electronic device on the African community values (respect, unity and hard work),
2. discuss the lessons learnt from the story,
3. identify the features that made the story telling session interesting,
4. work with peers to put together a collection of proverbs and wise sayings,
5. discuss the meaning of the proverbs and wise sayings,
6. write the proverbs and wise sayings on sentence strips and display them in class,
7. create proverbs and sayings

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Storytelling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: The learner speaks engagingly when narrating the short story created to other learners in

class.

• Creativity and Imagination: This will be realised as the learner exchanges ideas that inspire creativity when composing a

short story with proverbs and sayings on good values of a community.
